why: I checked each verifier check's PASS and FAIL conditions against the words of its expect line. Check 1 passes when the CSV and TSV outputs are identical ("SAME") and the CSV output is a JSON array for the given table. It fails on DIFFERENT, on an error, or on tab-joined keys, and that last case is just a kind of difference. All of this follows from "prints the same JSON array… for the same table as CSV". The base output quoted in parentheses only illustrates the result and adds no requirement. Check 2 requires that grep finds --tsv in README.md and that the nearby text explains the flag. This follows from "documents --tsv", and the check asks for no exact wording. The stricter checks (npm test, CSV behaviour unchanged, a CLI test) all sit under "Advisory (not a PASS/FAIL condition)". The criterion holds across the whole output.
